High enough to hold ice in the shaded corners early and late in the year. Next is Andermatt, mostly downhill.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 31 km. 882 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2383 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 30 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

scenicChapters.title: Furka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 7.5%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter — first and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.

scenicChapters.title: Furka-Grimsel-Susten Pass Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: 34 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

julier-albula-fl-ela-graub-nden-triangle.story: 665 km round from Chur - plan on about 12 h 47 of riding. The climbs: Julierpass high road, Albula Pass railway country, Flüelapass high section and Lukmanier pass road. It tops out at 2,383 m. Lenzerheide Pass, Albula Pass, Fluela Pass and Lukmanier Pass are subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It is a high-mountain day.

legend-bertha-benz-memorial-route.slogan: Bertha Benz Memorial Route – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-bertha-benz-memorial-route.story: official historic route. historic motoring, Rhine plain, towns. A one-way ride of 74 km, Mannheim to Pforzheim - roughly 1 h 21 in the saddle. The stops in between: Schwetzingen, Wiesloch and Bruchsal. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Castle Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 14 km this is Castle Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
